description: Shared defaults for my app repos (autopakr, pakr, ynab, synology-tui). Weekly and grouped, so each batch runs CI once. Patches merge themselves once CI passes (a repo without PR checks never automerges: Renovate waits for a green status); minors and majors wait for review. homelab has its own config. Toolchain rules match dep names: the package name of a Docker image or a mise tool is often not the bare tool name.

packageRules.description: Patches that pass CI merge themselves on the weekly run. Renovate merges (not GitHub's auto-merge), so a red or missing check stops it.
Major versions: one PR each, always reviewed.
The Go toolchain in mise.toml and the Dockerfile's builder image move together.
